title: slug redirects
description: data/redirects.json: the slug tombstone table. Each namespace maps a RETIRED slug - a record the database no longer holds, e.g. the loser of a duplicate merge - to the live slug that replaced it, so a URL or a stored id keeps resolving. Not a pack file and not a family: a retired slug is not an entity. metacheck additionally requires that a source is never a live id, a target always is, and no target is itself a source.

people.description: Retired person slugs, keyed by the retired slug. The target addresses /api/v1/people/{id}.

series.description: Retired series slugs, keyed by the retired slug. The target addresses /api/v1/series/{id}.

works.description: Retired work slugs, keyed by the retired slug. The target addresses /api/v1/works/{id}, and a recording travels with its work.
